name: MusicGen Small

outcome.title: MusicGen Small
outcome.blurb: Instrumental sketches from a text prompt. No singing. One card.

traits.cards_note: one card; instrumental only — it has no lyrics input

notes: MusicGen is not a family the audio.cpp engine carries, so it runs as its own Python job, like MiniMax (worker/musicgen_job.py).
Duration is a token budget: 50 frames per second, so 120 s asks for 6,000 frames (generation_config max_length 1500 = 30 s per call by default).
The checkpoint is 'small' (2.36 GB of fp32 weights) because 'medium' is 8.04 GB to download and the box's link to Hugging Face is bursty; small is what fits the wait.
rate is a declared guess of 1.0 until three finished songs replace it with a measured median (catalog.ts does that itself).
Pinned to card 0 (CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0): the box is run one card per model, and cards 1 and 2 are kept free.
